thread:
Sarah: Quick share — ran a cross-family GPTQ bake focused on variance decomposition across Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-7B. Methods: GPTQ (8-bit), AWQ (4/8 hybrid), FP8 experimental. Short take: average closed-book QA EM drops small (~1-2%), but we see tail instruction-following regressions up to ~8-12% on a few prompts. Pasting quant config and a few numbers below.

Diego: Can you drop the eval numbers and latency/kv profiles? curious about what we'd actually ship for Dedicated.

Sarah: TL;DR numbers (eval sets: redwood-instr-50k, MMLU, TruthfulQA, custom summarization probes):
- Llama2-13B GPTQ-8: EM -1.4%, p50 latency +1ms, p95 +6ms, KV memory on A100-80: ~42GB used.
- Mistral-7B GPTQ-8: EM -0.7%, p50 -2ms, p95 -8ms (better packing), KV ~28GB.
- Qwen-7B GPTQ-8: EM -2.1%, p50 +3ms, p95 +15ms, noted more tokenization mismatch on few instr tasks.
- AWQ-4 hybrid (Mistral): EM -3.5% vs fp16 but latency wins x1.8 and peak memory -40% (good for Dedicated-constrained).
- FP8 exp (Llama2): noisy on >8k context, occasional numeric spikes during KV rolling; not production-ready.

Quick config used for GPTQ run:
```
quant_method: gptq
bits: 8
block_size: 128
per_channel: true
calibration_data: redwood-calib-10k.jsonl
clip_stats: median
use_fast_kv: true
```

Matt: Any safety/hallucination regressions? which task hit the 8-12% tail?

Sarah: Safety checks (TruthfulQA + redwood-halluc-probes) mostly stable. The 8-12% tail was concentrated on instruction-following summarization with injected edge prefixes — Qwen-AWQ produced shorter outputs that dropped ROUGE and altered instruction compliance. Repro case: prompt with nested bullet constraints (I can paste).

Elaine: Can you upload the artifacts and set up a canary route if we think OK? I can coordinate a small Dedicated canary.

Sarah: Uploaded tgz to s3://redwood-quant/2124567890/{llama2-gptq8,mistral-awq4,qwen-gptq8}. Artefacts include model.bin, quant-metadata.json, and a small repro harness. Canary config I pushed to repo under ops/canaries/gptq-2124567890.yaml — route: 10% traffic to quant model, fallback to fp16 on perplexity spike. Example rollout snippet:
```
route: "\/generate"
variants:
  - id: mistral-awq4
    pct: 10
    fallback: mistral-fp16
    thresholds:
      token_kl: 0.12
      avg_logprob_drop: 0.9
```

Sarah: Next steps (proposal): run token-level KL checks + 5k user-proxy evals, then gate by: EM drop <=1.5% across instr set AND no >5% single-prompt regression cluster. If pass -> canary 10% for 24h -> monitor costs + error budget.

eval-bot: eval-bot: full eval artifacts and interactive dashboard uploaded -> https://internal.redwood/evals/2124567890. Baselines and per-prompt diffs available (zip in s3).

Diego: nice. Could you paste the worst 3 repro prompts in thread so SRE can run load with those?

Sarah: will paste worst-3 in a follow-up message and open a tiny ticket for SRE. :thumbsup:
